snippet.title: Galaxian Wars: Alien Shooter — Gameplay (Custom ZX Spectrum Hybrid Engine)
snippet.description:
Gameplay of "Galaxian Wars: Alien Shooter", running on a custom hybrid game engine that combines modern host performance with hardware-accurate emulated ZX Spectrum subsystems.

🚀 Download the game on Google Play:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.evergame.broodwave

The engine delivers a rock-solid 50Hz retro game loop with flawless performance while strictly enforcing the legendary 8-bit computer's constraints: a fixed 256x192 resolution with authentic attribute clash, hardware-accurate palette luminance, and 100% precise audio.

🔊 Technical Specs:
- Proprietary AY-3-8910 Audio Hardware Emulation built from scratch.
- Cycle-Accurate Beeper & Phaser Sound Engine matching original hardware timings.
- Hardware-Accurate Video Subsystem replicating authentic ZX Spectrum display behavior and attribute clash.
- Modern high-performance hybrid architecture ensuring a perfectly smooth, stutter-free experience.

🎵 Music in this video:
"Fall Into the Dark With Me" by Oleg Nikitin (nq)
Listen to more of his amazing work here: https://zxart.ee/eng/authors/n/nq/tab:music/
(Used with the author's permission).

⏳ Timestamps:
00:05 - Title Screen (AY-3-8910 Chiptune Emulation. Music by Oleg Nikitin)
01:38 - Core Gameplay (Cycle-Accurate Beeper & Phaser Sound Engine)
